name: AI Carpet Companions
description: Gives two Carpet-mod fake players an AI brain (OpenAI) and a voice (ElevenLabs): one polite companion, one rude/prankster companion. Both act on their own and can be talked to with push-to-talk.

custom.aicompanions:note: Carpet is a RUNTIME requirement, not a compile-time one: this mod only ever sends /player ... text commands, so install the 'Carpet' mod (by altrisi/gnembon, Modrinth project 'carpet') into mods/ yourself alongside this jar.
